scope: Select independently shuffled puzzles with at least eight targets, at least 35 physical steps, and two distinct legal proposed intermediates. Generate intermediates from the present program only. A proposed value must serve at least two different existing computations. Freeze the selected rows before any trajectory search. The graft and protected arms use the identical graph; the random arm uses another reproducibly sampled proposal.
extension: Expand on a lane if the new protected or graft route strictly beats the ordinary result on at least one holdout row. Keep all strict improvements from all comparisons.
